title: RDP / Remote Desktop
summary: Remote Desktop sign-ins, disconnects and reconnects.

events.title: A Remote Desktop session signed in
events.meaning: A user signed in over Remote Desktop. The message shows the user and the source address.
events.next: Check the user and address if you did not expect a remote sign-in.

events.title: A Remote Desktop session signed out
events.meaning: A user signed out of a Remote Desktop session.
events.next: Use it with event 21 to see how long a session lasted.

events.title: A Remote Desktop session disconnected
events.meaning: A user's Remote Desktop session was disconnected but not signed out.
events.causes: The user closed the window, or the connection dropped.
events.next: If drops are unexpected, check the network between the two PCs.

events.title: A Remote Desktop session reconnected
events.meaning: A user reconnected to an existing Remote Desktop session.
events.causes: Normal remote use after a disconnect.
events.next: Use it with event 24 to see how often a connection drops.

events.title: A Remote Desktop session disconnected with a reason code
events.meaning: Windows recorded why a session was disconnected, as a reason code.
events.causes: A network drop, an idle limit, an admin action or a user action.
events.next: Look up the reason code in the message to see why the session ended.

events.title: A Remote Desktop user was authenticated
events.meaning: A user passed the network check for a Remote Desktop connection, before the sign-in finished.
events.causes: A normal connection attempt, or someone probing the PC.
events.next: Check the user and source address. Many from unknown addresses can mean an attack.
